behaviors.source: GH #263 AC5 (prd.md D2 source 4; .kiro/specs/afk-v2-acceptance-scope-gates/slices/{02,03,05,08}/{contract-review.json,qa-review.json}; PR #256 merge commit dbd6fdc)
behaviors.given: the four PRD 4 cases 06-prd4-contract-a.json (slice 02-behavior-coverage-gate), 07-prd4-contract-b.json (slice 05-test-cost-split-and-caching), 08-prd4-qa-a.json (slice 03-candidate-evaluator-isolation) and 09-prd4-qa-b.json (slice 08-file-scope-gate), one role per slice and at most one case of either role per slice
behaviors.when: the pack is read, each of the four cases is inspected, and each case's expected is compared against the committed verdict artifact its source names
behaviors.then: 06- and 07- have role evaluator-contract and expected {"verdict":"ACCEPT"} equal to the verdict member of their slice's committed contract-review.json; 08- and 09- have role evaluator-qa and expected {"verdict":"PASS","failureClass":"NONE"} equal to the verdict and failureClass members of their slice's committed qa-review.json; and each of the four source strings names that artifact's repo-relative path under .kiro/specs/afk-v2-acceptance-scope-gates/slices/ and contains the literal substring "confirmed-by: dbd6fdc", the reachable record that the slice merged to main on that verdict in PR #256
behaviors.observableResult: a unit test named for B-05 asserts the two-and-two role split; for each of the four cases it reads the repo-relative verdict artifact path out of the case's source, loads that committed JSON file from the repository, and asserts the case's expected deep-equals the projection of that file's verdict (plus failureClass for the two qa cases); and it asserts each of the four source strings contains the literal "confirmed-by: dbd6fdc"
